title: Transcript record
description: One line of a stored transcript whose run used kinds (its run's end records transcriptFormat kinds): a record the runner sent with run/transcript, with its kind, after troupe masked the run's credential in it. Each line is compact JSON with its keys in this order, followed by a line feed. A transcript whose run didn't use kinds holds the records themselves, one per line, and no such object.

kind.description: What kind of record it is.

record.description: The record as the runner sent it, without its line ending, with the run's credential masked: the text, or base64 of the bytes when encoding is base64.

encoding.description: base64: the runner sent the record as base64 of bytes that aren't text. Absent: the record is the text.
